limitations: E1 records omit top-level and solver submitted source hashes even for valid rollouts; invalid/flagged early exits also omit reexecution source hashes.
Primary/replay source hashes agree on every recorded pair; journal submitted-source bindings checked where both metadata and stage hashes exist. Source bytes were not re-executed or reconstructed.
Runtime binding is batch-level; per-row metadata does not store a separate runtime hash.
method: Rows matched by index to gzip plan; exact lifecycle, policy zero/no retry, all resource IDs/names unique across attempt owners, removal and stage tracking checked; journal bytes concatenated in listed order and SHA256 checked, metadata exact against journal JSON; current source hashes recomputed with phase.runtime_version_hash algorithm.
review_scope: Every saved row, attempt resource event and referenced/full-directory exception journal; no runtime execution.
